From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@aeronimbus.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@aeronimbus.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: AeroNimbus: FinOps intake & seller setup (billing + PO routing)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for agreeing to list on the Redwood Inference channel. To keep the activation moving and to avoid back-and-forth with Finance, can you confirm the following and return the attached FinOps intake form by EOD Friday? I pulled together the minimum items Finance needs to create a PO lane and enable billing in AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces.

Key asks (please fill in the attached PDF):
- Legal company name and W-9 / tax ID (or VAT ID for non-US)
- Billing address and preferred invoice recipient (name + email)
- PO acceptance window / standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.)
- Preferred marketplace(s) to list: AWS, Azure, GCP (check all that apply)
- Any reseller-tax setup (if you route via third-party reseller)

What I attached: AeroNimbus_FINOPS_Form_v2.pdf (FinOps intake), AWS_Seller_Enrollment_Template.xlsx (example mapping).

Once we have that back, Naomi (cc) will create the PO routing in our systems and confirm the marketplace-specific paperwork you'll need to sign. Vanessa will coordinate the activation sprint once paperwork is signed.

If you prefer, we can jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the form. Proposed times: 10:00am or 2:00pm PT.

Thanks —

Maya Srinivasan
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AeroNimbus_FINOPS_Form_v2.pdf (PDF, 140KB)]
[Attachment: AWS_Seller_Enrollment_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 65KB)]

Maya —

Great, thanks for the clear list. We're on it. A couple quick questions before we fill out the PDF:

1) Our legal entity is AeroNimbus Labs, Inc. — we have a US EIN but also a UK VAT that may be used for EMEA listings. Which field should we prioritize in the form?
2) For marketplace selection: we want AWS + GCP initially; Azure later in Q4. Is there any reason to choose a single first marketplace for PO setup?

Tom (cc) is our finance lead — his email is tom.reeves@aeronimbus.com and he prefers invoices routed to finops@aeronimbus.com.

We'll target to return the completed form by Thursday EOD.

Thanks —

Sara Lin
Head of Partnerships
AeroNimbus Labs

Sara / team —

Quick clarifications from FinOps side:
- If you have both EIN and VAT, please provide both on the intake form; we'll create region-tagged PO lanes so EMEA can be routed to the VAT where possible.
- For the marketplaces: AWS + GCP together is fine for initial listing. We only need a single canonical billing entity to back the PO lane. If you plan to invoice under different legal entities per region, note that on line 6 of the PDF.
- Please confirm preferred payment terms (Net 30 default). If you need Net 45/60, let us know now so we can route to Finance approvers.

Action items after you return the form: Naomi will set up the PO lane and open vendor profile in our vendor portal; I will create an activation plan and schedule the technical onboarding sprint (30 minutes).

Best —

Vanessa Ortiz
Seller Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
